findings.statement: The total expense amount is calculated by summing all entries in the 'amount' column.
findings.code: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_expense FROM expenses;

data_quality_notes: The 'note' column has 59 nulls (98.3%) but no duplicates.
All 60 'amount' values are non-null and numeric.
The 'category' column has 3 distinct values with no nulls.
assumptions: The 'amount' column contains accurate and complete expense values.
The 'note' column's nulls do not correlate with missing expense data.
limitations: The 'note' column's high null rate may indicate incomplete metadata, but it does not affect the 'amount' total.
